CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2588 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a. Bus nonce: 566ff789bf4f35118501560f72d41fc7. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a` or `Fix review: blocked ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 566ff789bf4f35118501560f72d41fc7`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2588 ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2588-566ff789`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2588 (the round-10 roster PR, branch fix/audit-r10-roster-pr) at head ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a. The previous verdict at 922640dc was blocked figure-wrong (body stated 141 groups, 33 new, 27 changed; the roster had 144, 36, 29). The body has since been re-cut MINIMAL by a body seat and applied at this unchanged head: every figure it keeps is stated beside the command that derives it. The roster ref is frozen at 306a96d5f, so this head will not move under you.
Read every open block and Carry with `git fetch origin review/2588; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md` and confirm each is cleared at this head. Re-derive every body figure by running the command printed beside it, at this head. Check what changed since 922640dc (git log --format='%h %s' 922640dc..ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a: roster_edit append-carry, edit-brief, set-stage commits and main merges) and that each roster edit is well-formed (jq parses dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json; every carry cites a PR; stages are valid).
Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body reports 0 unrouted; every Carry in your verdict names a live group. ## Red checks from the check-runs API per commit at this head (nightly-status grades main; main's ci-ratchet red is runner-speed variance owned by R10-CI-LAYOUT). git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main ad10fd2153c6c8fe2e1d56c8b0302c5b057cc37a clean. ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head; VERDICT carries bus-nonce: 566ff789bf4f35118501560f72d41fc7.
